text.conclusion: McNemar chi-square = 3.125 with 1 df is below chi-square_0.05(1) = 3.841. Do not reject H0 (P > 0.05). None of the 20 subjects has hypertension, so every positive is a false positive. The machine gives 10 false positives and the person gives 4, and the 8 disagreements split 7 against 1, but that split is not enough to show a difference in specificity.
